FIX Owner: 'General Petroleum Co' (GPC) 100% is unsupported and almost certainly wrong for a Petrobel-operated Baltim SW line; owner should reflect the Petrobel JV (Eni + EGPC). validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE - CONFIRMED, high confidence. This is the ONSHORE segment of the pipeline built for the Baltim South West (Baltim SW) gas development, offshore Nile Delta, ~12 km off the Mediterranean coast of Kafr El Sheikh. The sheet's own primary ref (sfegypt.com/4657, Smart Finance, 2019-08-27, Arabic) explicitly reports the ministry completed 'mad khatt bahri bi-tul 18 km wa-qutr 26 busa wa-akhar barri bi-tul 25 km wa-qutr 26 busa' = a MARINE (offshore) line 18 km / 26 in AND an ONSHORE (land) line 25 km / 26 in, plus installation of the offshore production platform, for Baltim field development, operator Petrobel. Independently, Eni's 2019-09 press release confirms a 'new 44 km long, 26 inch diameter pipeline' connecting the Baltim SW platform to the existing onshore Abu Madi Gas Plant, start-up 17 Sep 2019, 500 MMscf/d target by Q2 2020, operated by Petrobel (jointly held by Eni and EGPC). Daily News Egypt (2019-08-27) and Eni corroborate operator + timing. 18 km (offshore) + 25 km (onshore) ~= the single 44 km line Eni describes.

DUPLICATE - NOT a duplicate of P7577. P7577 (segment 'Sub-Sea Pipeline', 18 km) and P7578 (segment 'Onshore Pipeline', 25 km) are the two physical halves (offshore + onshore) of ONE 44 km Baltim SW->Abu Madi export line, deliberately split into two ProjectIDs with distinct segment names. Legitimate segmentation, not double-counting the same pipe. GulfPub's Baltim lines ('Baltim East - Abu Madi' 16 in/18 km; 'Baltim North - Abu Madi' 16 in/31 km) are the OLDER original-Baltim-field lines (16 in), not this 2019 Baltim SW 26 in development - different diameter, different vintage; no confident GulfPub counterpart for P7578, so no duplicate flag.

CLASSIFICATION - OK. Onshore 25 km / 26 in trunk from the coast landfall to the Abu Madi Gas Plant; a gas transmission/export line, not a gathering or plant-internal line. 'transmission' is appropriate. Fuel=Gas confirmed (dry gas + condensate field).

SPEC - Length 25 km CONFIRMED (sfegypt; consistent with Eni's 44 km combined). Diameter 26 in CONFIRMED (sfegypt onshore line; Eni combined line). StartYear 2019 CONFIRMED (Eni: production start 17 Sep 2019). Capacity 500 MMcf/d = the FIELD production target (Eni: '500 million scf/d by Q2 2020'; petro-news/95212 attributes 500 MMcf/d to the Baltim SW platform/6-well program) - it is a field capacity, and the SAME 500 sits on both P7577 and P7578, so it is not additive line throughput (spec caveat, not an error per se).

ATTRIBUTION - Operator 'Belayim Petroleum Co' (Petrobel / bitrul bala'im) CONFIRMED by sfegypt + Eni PR. Owner 'General Petroleum Co' (GPC) 100% is the real problem: the cited sfegypt article does NOT state ownership, and Baltim SW is a Petrobel concession jointly held by Eni (via IEOC) and EGPC (Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation). 'General Petroleum Company' (GPC) is a distinct EGPC subsidiary (Gulf of Suez operator) and is not the Baltim SW owner - this looks like a name mis-mapping (GPC vs EGPC / vs Petrobel). Flagging for owner correction.

routes.start_name: Baltim SW landfall (Mediterranean coast near Baltim), Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt
routes.end_name: Abu Madi Gas Plant, Nile Delta, Egypt
routes.corridor_desc: Onshore segment (~25 km, 26 in) of the Baltim South West export line. It begins where the 18 km offshore line comes ashore on the Mediterranean coast of Kafr El Sheikh governorate (landfall near the town of Baltim, east of Lake Burullus) and runs roughly south/southeast inland across the northeastern Nile Delta to the existing Abu Madi Gas Plant. Endpoints are sourced (Eni names Abu Madi Gas Plant; sfegypt gives the 25 km onshore length and Baltim landfall); the precise landfall point and exact alignment are not published, so treat the corridor as an ~25 km coast-to-Abu-Madi band rather than a surveyed route. Coordinates are approximate, derived from the named places (Baltim town ~31.55N/31.10E; Abu Madi ~31.30N/31.37E) and are consistent with a ~25 km onshore run.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent sources: Eni PR (platform -> existing onshore Abu Madi Gas Plant via a 44 km 26 in line) and sfegypt (offshore 18 km + onshore 25 km split). Onshore terminus Abu Madi Gas Plant is firm. Start landfall = Mediterranean coast near Baltim; exact ashore point not published so start coordinate is an approximate coastal point at Baltim. No coordinates fabricated - both are defensible approximations of named places; intermediate alignment left as a corridor, not invented waypoints.

summary: P7578 confirmed real (onshore 25 km/26 in half of the 2019 Baltim SW->Abu Madi export line); caveat: Owner 'General Petroleum Co' 100% likely wrong (should be Petrobel/Eni+EGPC), and Capacity 500 is the field target shared with P7577, not additive throughput.
